content:
We’re hiring a full-time Formal Verification Engineer at Common Prefix to work on machine-checked proofs of blockchain protocols and smart contracts.

You’ll work with mathematical specifications and invariants to reason about protocol behavior, connecting formal models to real implementations across distributed systems and cryptographic mechanisms. Experience with Lean4, Coq, F*, or TLA+ and with non-trivial systems (e.g. distributed systems, compilers, smart contracts) is relevant.

:pin: More details and applications here: https://commonprefix.notion.site/fve-folk

Feel free to reach out by DM or at luz[at]commonprefix[dot]com
